questions.body:
Tonight you play in teams.

Fifty boxes. Five categories. One big gamble.

Grab your phone: you will be put on a team.

Every team starts with 10,000 points.

Your captain picks a box and decides how much to gamble.

Right: you win the stake. Wrong: you lose it.

Not sure? Pass for half the stake, but everyone sees the question.

Five powers, once each. Use them wisely.
